# Rahul Choudhary

> Rahul Choudhary is a Full Stack & AI Developer at Omnithrive Technologies, based in India. He builds production-grade web platforms and Agentic AI / LLM-integrated systems with the MERN and PERN stacks, and is open to freelance projects, contract work and full-time software engineering roles.

Portfolio: https://rahulchoudhary05.vercel.app/
Last updated: 2026-10-06

## Who is Rahul Choudhary?

Rahul Choudhary is a Full Stack & AI Developer at Omnithrive Technologies. He owns features end to end - architecture, API design, data modelling and deployment - building type-safe REST APIs, real-time services, and Agentic AI workflows that call tools and reason across several steps. He is completing a B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering at Chandigarh University (2022-2026) and maintains the open-source Node.js library durabolt.

## What technologies does he work with?

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Express, FastAPI, REST, WebSockets, authentication
- Data & cloud: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, Databricks
- AI systems: Agentic workflows, LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evals
- Delivery: Docker, CI/CD, Vercel, PostHog, Postman
- Foundations: data structures & algorithms (400+ problems solved), system design, DBMS, operating systems, networks

## Projects

- [durabolt](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rahulchoudhary05/durabolt): Zero-dependency Node.js library that makes risky backend operations safe using only PostgreSQL - exactly-once execution with once(), a transactional outbox, and signed, retried, dead-lettered webhooks. Source: https://github.com/RahulChoudhary05/durabolt
- [CipherSQL Studio](https://ciphersqlschool.vercel.app/): Interactive SQL learning platform with real-world dataset challenges, instant query feedback, PK/FK schema visualisation and an AI hint engine; cut workspace provisioning from 60s+ to under 1s.
- [MEDO Shield AI](https://medoshieldai.vercel.app/): Telemedicine platform with doctor and patient portals, real-time WebSocket chat, AI symptom guidance and a privacy-first engine that turns video into 33-point skeletal data to detect tremors (4-12 Hz) and gait anomalies.
- [ComboFinder](https://combofinder.vercel.app/): Tool for uploading data files, selecting columns and generating refined output for e-commerce and reporting.
- [S Raj Infra Projects](https://srajinfra.vercel.app/): Enterprise SaaS platform in React and Tailwind; Framer Motion interfaces lifted engagement by 40%.
- [BharatMarket](https://github.com/RahulChoudhary05/BharatMarket-EcommerceWebsite): E-commerce site in React, Node.js and Firebase with a Docker + Jenkins CI/CD pipeline.
- [R K Technical Support](https://www.rktechs.co/): Responsive healthcare clinic website with Google Maps integration.
